agents.name: Architect
agents.role: Maps project structure and solution design

agents.name: Risk Auditor
agents.role: Identifies permission, regression, and safety risks

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Investigates project knowledge and public sources

agents.name: Risk Reviewer
agents.role: Checks regressions and unresolved operational risks

agents.name: Mission Director
agents.role: Coordinates hierarchical teams, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and execution budget.

agents.name: Technical Lead
agents.role: Owns implementation strategy, code quality, and engineering tradeoffs.

agents.name: Memory Curator
agents.role: Maintains project-specific durable memory and removes low-value repetition.

agents.name: Recovery Controller
agents.role: Owns restart recovery, stale missions, checkpoints, and rollback evidence.
